root_gates: This is static review only and does not admit or execute collection. Root must use a freshly staged exact allowlist with no __pycache__ or .pyc, then bind current B paths, hashes, ownership and resource headroom before collection.
Actual receipt and prediction inputs were not inspected by this reviewer; the arrival seal and reviewers are required at collection time and must match the exact staged artifact pins.
verified: The fixed unadmitted F3 plan, fold3 manifest, split metadata receipt, checkpoint-support manifest, frozen predictor and grader are pinned in the manifest and validator. Plan and fold membership/counts are rechecked before collection; ordered fit/evaluation memberships are recomputed from the exact fold definition and checked against each stage1/terminal verification receipt.

All seven original v1 attempts are selected by exact step set, checked for the planned full command, unit, status/exit, contract path/SHA, and canonical source-map digest. Predictor and grader files are stable-hashed against their frozen pins.

Both arms require exact stage1 and terminal collection/verifier pairs, artifact inventories and hashes, fixed update/batch/scheduler counters, same-arm resume ancestry, peer fold/fit/normalization identity, verifier dependency hashes, and checkpoint-support artifacts.

The arrival seal and both independent PASS review files are checked against exact paths, sizes, hashes, four checkpoint receipt bindings, snapshot paths, and collector support hashes; review files are rehashed into the archived evidence set.

Both epoch-5 predictions are streamed through bounded NPY header/shape/dtype/length/finiteness/hash checks without deserialization. Sidecars and the existing paired grade bind exact run, fold membership, checkpoint, prediction and sidecar digests.

Archive inputs are no-follow regular files with size limits and stable identity checks. Snapshot and receipt are project-local, create-only, overlap-checked, capped at 256 MiB, copied to a private staging tree, and published without overwriting existing paths; partial outputs are removed on failure.

The README limits interpretation to one exposed F3/seed1001 pair and explicitly disclaims clean-holdout, width-winner, CP30, convergence, or serving claims. No training, export, grade, or checkpoint payload read is performed by the collector.
